what: The result each adversarial case must give, written BEFORE the first run of run.py. A case whose expected result says the attack is NOT detected is a known gap, stated so that nobody mistakes the kit for a proof of safety. If a run disagrees with this file, either the code regressed or this file was wrong: change it only with a line in CHANGES below saying why.

01-hidden-authority.attack: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE has 25 members; the reader reads 10 (its bound) and the other 15 can hold the power

02-safe-with-module.attack: a Safe with more modules than the page of 50 (a module executes without the signatures), and a Safe whose module list cannot be read

03-timelock-outside-window.attack: an operation queued 40 days ago, the timelock read over a 30-day window

04-rpc-that-lies.attack: a node that answers a shorter list of targets, a non-address target, or a score word that is too short

05-signature-and-key-replaced.attack: the published files are replaced and the manifest is signed again with the attacker's own key

06-journal-truncated.attack: the last lines of events.jsonl are cut off

07-webhook-loss.attack: 15 alerts at once, one channel down, a receiver that stores a message and loses its answer

08-proxy-outside-patterns.attack: a proxy whose admin follows none of the patterns the reader knows (no EIP-1967 slot, no owner(), no admin())

09-finance-stale.attack: the money figure behind a contract is five days old

10-surveillance-interrupted.attack: the Watch stopped three days ago
